mainEntity.name: How long does a kitchen renovation project usually take from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a kitchen renovation project varies depending on its complexity and scope. A small-scale cosmetic update, such as refacing cabinets and new paint, might take 3-5 weeks. A mid-range renovation involving new cabinets, countertops, flooring, and minor layout changes typically spans 6-10 weeks. Extensive custom renovations with structural modifications, plumbing, or electrical reconfigurations can take 10-16 weeks or longer. Our team works efficiently to minimize disruption, and we provide a clear project timeline during the planning phase.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen renovations typically take 3-5 weeks for cosmetic updates, 6-10 weeks for mid-range projects, and 10-16+ weeks for extensive custom remodels. Timing depends on project scope.
